    ans = []
    taken = 0
    i = 0
    n = len(s)
    while i < n:
        c = s[i]
        if c == 'a':
            if i + 1 < n and s[i+1] == 't' and ans and not taken:
                taken = 1
                ans.append('@')
                i += 2

                ans.append('.')
                i += 3
                continue
        ans.append(c)
        i += 1
    print(''.join(ans))

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
